notes: Event Shop: each account has a Buy list and a Leftover list, set any time. Leftover coins are spent in the last hours before a shop closes. The War Prep Chest switch becomes a Leftover item. Bulk apply copies only the Event Shop settings. Proxies: stopped and new accounts get the least-used proxy. Mass Relocator: its type list works with the mouse, the numbers are labelled, and it opens as part of Apex. Engine windows no longer show as separate apps. New tag and Rename use an Apex dialog. Right-click has Open folder. Notifications come from Apex.
